title: Documentation and present-tense comments still name 'tk factory/cloud' commands ticfac serves
body: cloudflare/README.md still says "`tk factory deploy` is the supported path" (~20 mentions), wrangler.toml and the D1 migration comments name `tk factory deploy` / `tk cloud status`, mint-factory-token.mjs's header says `tk factory deploy` will wrap it, and present-tense Go/TS comments (internal/factory/githubapp.go, credentials/credentials.go, status.go, dashboard/client.go + snapshot.go, deploy.go:532, gatewaytrace/trace.go:30, cloudflare/src/gateway.ts and runs.ts docblocks) name the old commands as the ones to run. These are maintainer- and doc-reader-facing, not binary output, so ogv left them; a sweep needs a historical-vs-current pass (D15/D16 decision records and incident narratives must stay as written), which is why it is a tick rather than a sed.
